top_headlines.headline: Morgan Stanley lifts MU and SNDK targets, sees 2-3 years of tight memory supply
top_headlines.summary: Morgan Stanley more than doubling MU target to $1,050 from $520 with a 2-3 year tight supply outlook provides exceptional earnings visibility and institutional price target support.

top_headlines.headline: Nvidia Certifies Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron for HBM4 Supply
top_headlines.summary: Nvidia's HBM4 certification of all three major memory vendors including Micron confirms MU's place in the next-gen AI accelerator supply chain for Vera Rubin.

top_headlines.headline: Micron to deliver another strong quarter, Goldman says
top_headlines.summary: Goldman Sachs sharply raises Micron estimates and price target citing tightening supply and surging AI demand, with the stock up 4% in premarket on the note.

top_headlines.headline: Micron Price Targets Rise as Memory Shortage Continues
top_headlines.summary: Morgan Stanley doubling its MU price target to $1,050 on a multi-year memory shortage outlook is the most significant single analyst upgrade in MU's recent history.

top_headlines.headline: Nvidia certifies Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron for Vera Rubin HBM4 supply
top_headlines.summary: Nvidia certifying Micron for HBM4 supply on the Vera Rubin AI platform locks in a high-volume, high-margin revenue stream for MU's advanced memory business.
